report:
Liver, segment 7 mass, biopsy

Sections show two cores of liver measuring 22 mm in aggregate length. The cores are infiltrated by moderately differentiated hepatocellular carcinoma. The tumour cells are hepatocyte-like, with moderate nuclear atypia, and grow in thickened trabeculae and pseudoglandular structures. On immunohistochemistry, the tumour cells are positive for HepPar-1, arginase-1 and glypican-3, and negative for CK7 and CK19. CD34 shows diffuse sinusoidal staining. There is loss of the reticulin framework. The background liver shows chronic hepatitis B. There is cirrhosis (Ishak stage 6/6).

LIVER, segment 7 mass, biopsy - Moderately differentiated HEPATOCELLULAR CARCINOMA; background liver shows CHRONIC HEPATITIS B with CIRRHOSIS (Ishak stage 6/6)
